report.explanation: Current telemetry shows healthy checkout behavior: gateway trace OK at 62ms, gateway and order error rates 0.0012, p95 79ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, and INFO 200 logs. No taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration) is substantiated. The order deployment record alone cannot establish latency or failure. Evidence is insufficient to name a root cause; hand off for further data.
missing_evidence: Alert definition and threshold that triggered the checkout health alert
Time series of error rate, latency, and saturation for gateway/order beyond the 5-minute window
Downstream inventory, payment, and postgresql metrics, logs, and traces
Redis and postgresql dependency latency and timeout telemetry
Evidence of any failing request or non-200 status in the alert window
